description: Shows long text clamped to a number of lines, with a Show more / Show less toggle that only appears when the text doesn't fit.

inputs.name: Text
inputs.description: The text. Line breaks are kept.
inputs.example: "OutSystems apps often show long descriptions, notes or comments in lists and cards. This one is clamped to three lines, with a toggle to read the rest without leaving the screen or opening a popup."

inputs.name: Lines
inputs.description: How many lines to show while collapsed. 0 or less uses 3.

events.name: OnToggled
events.description: Raised when the user expands or collapses the text.

params.name: IsExpanded
params.description: True when the text is now shown in full.

modifiers.description: Secondary text colour and a smaller size, for descriptions under a title.
